summary: Aligned web screen-share profile choices and encoder policy with Flutter's 720/1080/1440p by 15/30/60 FPS matrix. The web's in-room selection now also controls its persistent voice-dock start action.

checks.name: Web profile matrix and LiveKit capture/encoding mapping
checks.observation: 13 tests passed. Every profile maps to the expected 16:9 capture dimensions, FPS, bitrate, and track label; the component exposes all nine choices.

checks.name: Web profile propagation and voice presentation
checks.observation: 12 tests passed. The selected profile is passed from the workspace to the conversation settings and reused by the persistent voice dock.

checks.name: Flutter profile matrix
checks.observation: 6 tests passed, including all 9 resolution/frame-rate combinations and Android picker layout constraints.

checks.name: Web typecheck and production build
checks.observation: vue-tsc and Vite production build succeeded. Vite retains its existing warning that the minified LiveKit chunk is larger than 500 kB.

checks.name: Physical capture/visual acceptance
checks.observation: ADB returned an empty device list, so real browser/native capture, negotiated dimensions/bitrate, picker layout screenshots and network-load behavior were not exercised on hardware.

remaining: Compare the Flutter source/quality dialog with the web quality controls and viewer at matched viewports; exercise all profile choices against real capture on macOS, Windows and Android and inspect negotiated sender/receiver statistics.
